newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Teltrend started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Teltrend started as buy.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Teltrend Inc with a buy rating, noting that the company has become an important participant in the high-speed digital loop communications sector.
- Its EPS estimates are $1.82 for 1996 and $2.16 for 1997.

- "Teltrend's market-focused engineers are turning innovative products for markets that exist today, rather than taking on speculative projects that may or may not pay off," noted analyst Charles Pluckhahn in a report.
- Shares were up 3/4 at 47 in midafternoon trade Tuesday.
